units.source_text: 工作人员若是让名人一直空等，事情就办得很不漂亮。

en.t: If the staff kept the Master waiting indefinitely, it would make a very poor impression.

units.source_text: 可又不好对难得高兴的名人说，由于大竹七段的关系，又要再延期一天。

en.t: But it was also awkward to tell the Master, who was rarely in such good spirits, that because of Otake Seventh Dan they would have to postpone it for yet another day.

units.source_text: 名人说“从明天开始”，说得很坚决。

en.t: The Master said, "Starting tomorrow," and he said it with firm resolve.

units.source_text: 名人和七段的地位不同，必须说服七段。

en.t: The Master and the Seventh Dan were not in the same position, so the Seventh Dan had to be persuaded.
The Seventh Dan flew into a rage.

units.source_text: 他正在气头上，更不会答应了。

en.t: Since he was already angry, he was even less likely to agree.

units.source_text: 七段声称要放弃这盘棋。

en.t: The Seventh Dan declared that he would abandon the game.
